name: run-app-root
_overrides_rationale: /audit/all High (deps): @sveltejs/kit@2.59.x pulls cookie@^0.6.0, which has GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x (out-of-bounds chars in name/path/domain). Upstream hasn't bumped yet. Top-level override deduplicates direct copies but npm leaves SvelteKit's nested node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/node_modules/cookie@0.6.0 in place because the v0.x → v1.x range jump is outside SvelteKit's declared dependency range. The nested @sveltejs/kit > cookie override forces that transitive copy too. The API surface SvelteKit uses is the v0.x compatible subset, so the bump is safe in practice. Drop both entries once @sveltejs/kit ships its own bump.
